title: eval metrics accepts tick-only logs
prompt: Update `clawsub eval metrics` so that when the log file contains only `tick:` heartbeat lines and no work-loop event lines, the command exits 0 and reports 0 events per repo (or an empty result) instead of exiting 1 with an error. Currently `clawsub eval metrics --log <tick-only-file>` exits 1 with: `error: 0 events parsed from N non-blank line(s) — verify log contains work-loop events`. A log with only tick lines is a valid idle log; the command must treat it as 0 events and succeed.
acceptanceCriteria: stdout reports 0 events (or an empty result) rather than an error message
exit code for a log with real events is unchanged
unit test covers the tick-only path
